research_question: Does the continuous-gap mechanism conclusion -- that predicted beat boundaries, not morphology, dominate the residual error -- survive when the 4 s/8 s input-support confound is removed?
motivation: The original C0-C5 audit ran on the 4s-crop incumbent whose event head reached only F1@100 0.10-0.54. The full-support B1/B2a models reach waveform-derived F1@100 0.83-0.86. The mechanism conclusion may therefore have been an artifact of the retired protocol.
prohibitions: No training of any kind; frozen checkpoints only.
No test split is opened. Validation only.
No modification of scripts/evaluate_continuous_gap_decomposition.py -- its scoring and assembly DEFINITIONS are frozen and imported unchanged.
No comparison of any number here against the old 4s-input C0-C5 results (docs/PROTOCOL_CONFOUND_4S_INPUT.md). The two are separate result sets and must never appear in one table.
No promotion of oracle-consuming conditions as achievable performance.

models.selection: already selected by the frozen full-waveform composite; not reselected here

PROTOCOL_DIFFERENCE_FROM_ORIGINAL_AUDIT.issue: The original audit drew each beat morphology from a DEDICATED shape-200 head. B1/B2a have no shape head; CENet returns only the full-window waveform and the event logits.
PROTOCOL_DIFFERENCE_FROM_ORIGINAL_AUDIT.resolution: Morphology is CROP-DERIVED: the model's own full-window output is cropped at the centre cycle and resampled to 200 points, i.e. the same crop path used elsewhere in this project for head-less comparators.
PROTOCOL_DIFFERENCE_FROM_ORIGINAL_AUDIT.consequence: C1-C5 here measure a DIFFERENT quantity from C1-C5 in the original audit. Cross-audit numerical comparison is FORBIDDEN. Only the qualitative question -- does the boundary contrast remain large? -- carries across.
PROTOCOL_DIFFERENCE_FROM_ORIGINAL_AUDIT.what_is_frozen: All scoring and assembly definitions are imported unchanged from scripts/evaluate_continuous_gap_decomposition.py: _metrics, _resample, _affine_fit, _global_cycles, _centre_cycle, _assemble_record. Only model loading and the source of the morphology differ.

C2.amplitude: ORACLE per-cycle affine fitted against the true ECG

C3.boundaries: predicted, from the event-head R mask

C4.boundaries: predicted, from the event-head R mask
C4.oracle_information: per-cycle gain/offset, plus window set selection

C5.boundaries: predicted, iterated over predicted cycles directly
C5.role: DESCRIPTIVE autonomous deployment behaviour, native coverage only, never differenced against C0-C4

residual_oracle_in_C3_C4: C1-C4 share an identical contributing-window set chosen using reference cycles. That is deliberate: it makes C1 vs C3 vary only the boundary source. It also means C3/C4 are NOT autonomous pipelines; C5 is the only autonomous figure.

scoring.target: the ORIGINAL ECG in native amplitude. _shape200_targets and normalize_01 must never touch the ground truth.
scoring.nrmse: RMSE divided by the peak-to-peak range of the original ECG over the sample set being scored
scoring.coverage: EVERY figure carries native coverage AND common support. Cross-arm comparison is computed on the common support of C0-C4 only; C5 is reported on its own native coverage.
scoring.no_manufactured_coverage: GT cycles with no genuine centre-cycle prediction stay uncovered and are never filled.

aggregation: per record, then fold mean, then fold-macro mean +/- sd over folds 1/5/9, reported per arm and per model (B1, B2a). Folds are never pooled into a single headline number.
contrast_framing: Pairwise contrasts on common support. NOT an additive decomposition; non-orthogonal and interacting. Phrases of the form 'X accounts for N of the gap' are forbidden. The C1-vs-C3 contrast is a BOUNDARY LOCALIZATION/WARPING contrast, since predicted bounds change both position and duration.
decision: Diagnostic only. Outcome determines whether the manuscript's continuous-gap section is rewritten, retained, or further bounded. No model claim may rest on it.
isolation: Outputs are written to experiments_mmecg/q1_cgd_reeval_fullsupport/, entirely separate from q1_continuous_gap_decomposition_audit/.
